attackers_goals: Attackers may seek access to FTP accounts and use them to exfiltrate data, stage attack tools, or create command and control channels through trusted services.
description: An FTP connection using an anonymous login was detected.
investigative_actions: Examine the legitimacy of the application that produced this FTP. Examine the parent process of this application. Verify that the connection attempts were not performed from an illegitimate source.
name: FTP Connection Using an Anonymous Login or Default Credentials
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
